page.title: GLPMGR by iSafeNet: Private GLP-1 Tracker App
page.description: GLPMGR is a free, private GLP-1 tracker for weight loss jabs and shots, on iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch: doses, dose steps, injection sites and weight.
page.lead: GLPMGR helps people on GLP-1 medicines keep track of their doses, dose steps, weight and how they feel, without an account and without their data leaving their device. It's written in plain English, with a gentle tone and no judgement, for Mounjaro, Wegovy, Ozempic and other GLP-1 medicines.
features: Log injections or tablets in a few taps. Reminders your way: a heads-up before a dose, a follow-up if it isn't logged, Log Dose and Snooze buttons, and low-supply alerts.
New in 2.2: Quick Log adds a glass of water or protein in one tap, Log Injection sits on Next Dose, and a dose fits on one screen. Made for iPhone Duo too.
Enter the steps your prescriber gave you and GLPMGR fills in the right dose each time, with each medicine's own leaflet wording on dose steps and missed doses.
Set up from wherever you are, from your first dose to maintenance. Something Changed? logs a step up or down, a break or finishing in plain English, and you can bring your doses from another app.
Only the areas each manufacturer lists for your region, with a body map of where you've injected before (Premium).
A gentle view of your progress, and a diary for how you feel, ready to share with your doctor or nurse.
Log water with one tap. With Premium, track protein: search thousands of foods, or scan a barcode or a nutrition label.
No account, no ads, no tracking, nothing in iCloud. Hide Medicine Names keeps your medicine off the Lock Screen, and progress photos are locked behind Face ID.
page.platforms_heading: Native on every screen it runs on.
platforms: Native layouts for each. On iPad in landscape, Today fits on one screen, and iPhone Duo gets its own layouts open, half open and closed.
Your next dose, weight, water and protein, one screen each. With Premium, a dose alarm that taps your wrist until you tap Taken.
Your next dose, water, protein, weight and journey on the Home Screen and Lock Screen, with a countdown when a dose is near (Premium).
Swift 6, SwiftUI, SwiftData, HealthKit, WidgetKit, ActivityKit, Vision, CryptoKit and StoreKit 2.
page.pricing: Free to use, with no time limits: doses and dose steps, reminders, weight, side effects, water, blood glucose, the Apple Watch app and backups. Premium adds more ways to see your progress, with a 7-day free trial on the yearly plan.
page.good_to_know: GLPMGR is a personal tracking tool, not a medical device, and it never suggests a dose or where to inject. Always follow the advice of your doctor, nurse or pharmacist.
page.learn_more: GLPMGR has its own website, with a full user guide, support and policies.
